title: Doppler Effect Simulation
description: An interactive MicroSim demonstrating how source motion affects observed frequency through wavefront compression and expansion. Shows wavefront behavior for approaching and receding sound sources.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Doppler effect
sound waves
frequency
wavelength
physics
wave mechanics
learningObjectives: Understand the key concepts of doppler effect
Explore doppler effect through interactive visualization
Apply knowledge of doppler effect to solve problems
Experiment with parameters to observe their effects on doppler effect
